headline: 3 American troops killed, and Trump says more 'likely,' in war against Iran
summary: Three U.S. service members were killed, the first American casualties since operation "Epic Fury" began on Saturday. President Trump said there would likely be more.
why: Direct US military involvement in a Middle East war affects defence spending, oil markets and broader risk sentiment.
